findings.source_quote: Disciple has almost the same spelling as discipline.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the author's original point about the English-word similarity. Suggested German rendering that preserves the intended meaning: "Im Englischen ist ‹disciple› fast genauso geschrieben wie ‹discipline›." (This keeps the observation that it is an English spelling similarity.)
findings.translation_quote: Das Wort Jünger hat fast die gleiche Schreibweise wie Disziplin.
